ini.Optimization_Mode: Module-level MPPT with full optimizer configuration
ini.Mounting_Type: PV module frame plate or T-shaped bolt (optional kit)
ini.Notes: Two model datasheet for MERC-1100W-P and MERC-1300W-P. The maximum power of the PV module at STC must not exceed the rated input DC power, with up to plus or minus 10 percent power tolerance allowed. A failed optimizer is bypassed in a string connected to an operating inverter. Safety output voltage is 1 V when disconnected from the inverter or the inverter is off. Overvoltage category II. IP rating IP68. Short input cable version has input wire 0.1 m and output wire 0.1 m positive with 5.1 m negative. A long input cable version with input wire 1.3 m and output wire 0.1 m positive with 2.9 m negative is available on request. String length per inverter: 8 to 25 optimizers for SUN2000-12~25K-MB0, SUN2000-12~25KTL-M5 and SUN2000-30~40KTL-M3, 8 to 20 for SUN2000-50KTL-M3, and 12 to 20 for SUN5000-150K-MG0. Every PV module under the same inverter must have a MERC-1100/1300W-P and SUN2000-450W-P2 or 600W-P cannot be mixed with it under the same controller.
